svg.text: 1 · The summary line stays above the collection, with the uplink notice when there is one.

2 · Devices are one auto-fill grid of cards at least 18 rem wide: 3 columns at 1280 px and 5 at 1920 px. Two screens keep their card width. Each card's actions sit at its foot, so a row's buttons line up.
3 · Recent leaves its side column (today at 1440 px and wider): it is a panel in the band under the devices, at most 48 rem wide, so it never runs beside short rows.
4 · Order: by name, A to Z, as today. A newly paired screen lands at its place; a screen going offline or moving to another zone does not move on the page.
5 · None: the shared empty state replaces the grid, one card across the content with its words at most 38 characters a line and the page's main action. Recent stays, saying nothing has happened yet.
